contracts.name: proof-gated exact-cell store-to-load forwarding
contracts.scope: mutable direct exact-cell loads with an available reaching stored SSA value
required_facts: LOAD has a classified direct storage identity and exact cell/index version
dataflow proves one compatible stored SSA value is available on every reachable path
no intervening may-alias or unknown write, call, effect, or control-flow ambiguity kills the value
store provenance and IR operands agree, and the source value is not redefined before an in-block use
proof_checks: analysis marks the load forwardable and reports its storage and value
every reaching store is an IR STORE carrying the reported SSA value
direct same-block forwarding requires all reaching stores before the load and one unchanged source register
otherwise a fresh temporary is copied at every reaching store site
transformed site count equals the number of proof-authorized loads
contracts.rewrite: replace only an authorized LOAD with a typed MOVE from the exact proven source register or fresh store-fed temporary
postconditions: all non-authorized IR instructions remain unchanged
candidate IR verifies and initialization analysis succeeds
reference, baseline IR, transformed IR, and native outputs agree in the recorded experiment protocol
contracts.fallback: KEEP_BASELINE_IR when no complete proof exists; abort the research candidate on provenance inconsistency

contracts.name: proof-gated cross-block exact-cell load reuse
contracts.scope: direct exact-cell LOAD candidates whose prior loaded SSA value is available on every CFG path and whose consumer is in another block
required_facts: source and candidate loads have equal classified storage identity and compatible type
the same loaded SSA value is available at the candidate on every reachable path
may-alias writes, unknown effects, calls, loop-carried ambiguity, and divergent incoming values kill or reject availability
the candidate is cross-block; same-block-only repetitions are excluded
proof_checks: analysis marks the candidate cross_block_available and forwardable
source sites resolve to exactly one defining IR LOAD with matching storage and SSA type
all candidates in a reuse group share storage and the same SSA source value
each authorized source gets a fresh typed temporary copy
selected site count equals the set of proof-authorized sites
contracts.rewrite: copy the unique source LOAD result into a fresh typed temporary and replace only authorized later LOADs with MOVEs from that temporary
postconditions: no load outside the proof-authorized selected set is rewritten
candidate IR verifies and initialization analysis succeeds
reference, baseline IR, transformed IR, and native outputs agree in the recorded experiment protocol
contracts.fallback: KEEP_BASELINE_IR when availability is unknown or killed; abort the research candidate on missing or inconsistent proof provenance

contracts.name: proof-gated cross-block load removal by dominating SSA-value substitution
contracts.scope: direct exact-cell cross-block LOAD candidates whose source SSA value is available on every reachable path and whose IR register uses can be rewritten without phi lowering
required_facts: the same loaded SSA value is available at the candidate on every reachable path
one exact source LOAD dominates the candidate and has compatible type/storage identity
reference, slice, aggregate, and length metadata agree across SSA values, IR instructions, and registers
source and target IR registers each have exactly one definition matching the SSA load sites
the target SSA value has no phi use and all ordinary operand uses map exactly to original IR operands
may-alias writes, unknown effects, calls, and control-flow ambiguity kill or reject availability
proof_checks: analysis marks the candidate cross_block_available and forwardable
source and target LOAD provenance, storage identity, types, and instruction indices agree between SSA and original IR
DominatorTree proves the source block dominates the target block
unique IR definitions and every target operand use are checked before rewriting
all other instructions remain in place; only the target LOAD is removed and its proved uses are substituted
contracts.rewrite: remove the authorized target LOAD, substitute the dominating source IR register in its exact SSA-mapped operand uses, and remove the now-dead target register
postconditions: phi-mediated targets and any source/target register with multiple definitions remain unchanged
candidate IR verifies and initialization analysis succeeds
reference, baseline IR, transformed IR, and native outputs agree in the recorded experiment protocol
contracts.fallback: KEEP_BASELINE_IR when availability, dominance, unique-register identity, or exact use mapping is not proven; abort on inconsistent provenance
